name: Screenpipe MCP
six_word_summary: Search screen and audio history locally.
who: Maintained by the Screenpipe team at Negentropy Labs, Inc.
what: Search locally captured screen text and audio transcripts through MCP for recall, meeting notes and work summaries. The stdio server also exposes meeting, memory and recording controls.
where: Runs alongside a Screenpipe recorder and its local API, normally at http://localhost:3030. Uses stdio by default; optional Streamable HTTP currently exposes search_content only.
when: Use when an assistant needs context from previously captured desktop activity or conversations.
why: Ground answers and summaries in searchable work history instead of asking users to reconstruct it manually.
with: A running Screenpipe recorder and an MCP client. Desktop Settings > Connections configures the bundled runtime and local API key. Manual setup uses Node.js 18 or later, npx -y screenpipe-mcp@latest and SCREENPIPE_LOCAL_API_KEY.
watch: Source-available under the Screenpipe Commercial License, not an OSI open-source license. Local credentials grant access to captured history and supported write/control tools. Configured cloud AI, transcription, sync, integrations and the connected client can transmit context off-device. Review permissions and configuration before connecting.
